title: NULL ops->sess_init dereference on init
description: Provider registers with NULL sess_init. User calls CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_INIT. crypto2dev_lookup_algo() returns ops. No NULL check before ops->sess_init() dereference at src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:627. Outcome: NULL function pointer dereference, kernel panic.
close_reason: Added NULL guards for ops->sess_init, ops->update, ops->finalize in crypto2dev_fd.c; returns -EOPNOTSUPP on NULL callback
